Real call-path tests: retry_rewrite with a pending review (no Run, request/feedback preserved, wrapped notice, second retry progresses), ordinary mismatched and queued starts, matching positive if the offline fixture allows, busy does not consume. Existing MCP controls remain. Static compile finding, not an executed red; no production fix made.
